title: Query node components inside each graph node for pre-layout
narrative: Before a run starts, Fangore’s console must place interior pieces inside each plan step — soft bindings, stop bounds, and nested child handles — so the camera can zoom into a node without inventing a parallel structure graph. Those pieces are node components of a parent graph node, not free-floating world nodes. Complements `fangore_insp_dynamic_subgraph` and `fangore_traversal_contract`.[^june-nc-req]
implementation: `mechaharness.node_component.node_components_for` derives `NodeComponent` rows from an `ExecutionGraph` plus optional template soft points and tool names. Kinds are limited to the closed catalog in `docs/reference/node-components.md` (events, soft points, child_graph, stop_contract, effect_state, budget_level). Every component requires `parent_node_id`. Soft points on Agentic Recipes appear as `soft_point` components.
validation: Harness `cli` `instantiate_recipe` loads `binds/conversational_tool_loop.yaml`; hard expects on node-component observation keys.

footnotes.label: Dynamic tool graph and node components
